title: Align task-sync capability and projection documentation with explicit shipped operations
outcome: Current capability prose consistently names shipped explicit task/evidence operations and the declared rebuildable projections.
acceptance: Shipped inventory and task-sync/planning briefs describe actual explicit delta, retention, origin-recovery and evidence allow-list behavior, separate from deferred unattended orchestration and code/data separation.
SQLite/spec projection documentation names the full declared rebuildable set or points to its authoritative code declaration without implying new durable conversions or granting authority.
